form: Nautilus Law Group — Estate Planning Questionnaire
notes: Fields marked conditional only appear when their condition is met.
Repeating sections document one instance; the section repeats N times based on user-entered count.
PersonList is a shared sub-component used for Executors, Guardians, Health Attorneys, and Financial Attorneys.
DistributionScenario is a shared sub-component used for all four distribution pages (C1/C2 × Primary/Contingency).
Couple-only pages (C2 Personal, C2 assets, C2 distributions, C2 executors, C2 EPA, etc.) are conditional on engType starting with 'Couple'.
Full-disclosure asset pages (Property, Financial, Super, Liabilities) are conditional on disclosureLevel = 'full'.
Summary page is conditional on disclosureLevel = 'summary'.
Guardians page is conditional on at least one child having a DOB less than 18 years ago.
Insurance detail pages are conditional on the corresponding c1HasIns / c2HasIns = 'Yes'.

notes_on_field_count: Top-level field count includes all direct fields plus repeating-group header fields (e.g. count inputs).
Sub-fields inside repeating_group cards are not double-counted in the top-level total.
Total unique sub-fields across all repeating groups (templates): ~130 additional leaf fields.
Combined total including all repeating-group template fields: ~328 unique fields.
Dynamic beneficiary profile cards (beneProfiles) count as 2 fields per beneficiary; number of beneficiaries is user-determined.
SMSF member name fields repeat memberCount times within each SMSF card; documented as one template entry.
validation_rules_applied: email: must contain @ and a valid domain (blur hint, non-blocking)
tel: must be 8–12 numeric digits after stripping spaces and hyphens (blur hint, non-blocking)
date (dob/relationship): must not be in the future; must not be more than 120 years in the past (blur hint, non-blocking)
date (declaration): must not be in the future
residuary percentages: all resBenes percentages must sum to 100% (shown as live counter)
required fields: validated on Next/Proceed; error summary scrolled to top of card
